The Client  

Redhearts Support Services is a NDIS Registered provider located in Victoria. They provide individualised care and support to their participants with disabilities. 

As the demand for such disability care services grows in the region, they seek a passionate and qualified Disability Services Officer to join their team. 

 

 

 

The Role 

This is for a full-time basis with an annual salary set at $80,000 to $85,000 depending on experience plus superannuation. The role will be based at 634 Springvale Road, Mulgrave VIC 3170. 

 

 

Responsibilities  

Assess the unique needs of clients to tailor individualized care plans. 

Plan, develop, and implement educational, training, and support programs to address clients' needs. 

Conduct client interviews to comprehensively understand and assess the nature and extent of difficulties. 

Monitor and track the progress of clients, ensuring regular assessments and documentation. 

Facilitate referrals to external agencies and resources that can provide additional assistance and support. 

Evaluate community needs and available resources related to health, welfare, housing, employment, training, and other services for individuals with disabilities. 

Liaise with community groups, welfare agencies, government bodies, and private businesses to address community issues and promote awareness of available resources. 

Provide support to families and deliver education and care services for children and disabled individuals in various settings, including adult service units, group housing, and government institutions. 

Assist young people in resolving social, emotional, and financial problems related to their disabilities. 

Prepare submissions for funding and resources, outlining the specific needs and goals of the disability care services organization. 

Generate reports for government bodies and other agencies to provide updates on the organization's activities and outcomes. 

Advocate for the rights and needs of individuals with disabilities within the community and relevant institutions. 

Identify and refer residents to external agencies for additional support when necessary. 

  

 

 

 

Requirements 

In order to be shortlisted for this position, the right candidate needs to have: 

Must hold a minimum Cert IV in Disability and Diploma in Community Services 

Minimum 12 months’ experience supporting participants with complex disability needs, including psychosocial disability, intellectual disability, autism, acquired brain injury and physical impairment 

At least 12 months’ experience implementing positive behaviour support strategies, behaviour observation records, escalation plans and restrictive practice reporting requirements 

Minimum 12 months’ experience coordinating high intensity support needs, including manual handling, dysphagia support, medication prompting, seizure response, continence support and mealtime management 

At least 12 months’ experience preparing detailed case notes, shift reports, incident reports, progress summaries, risk reviews and participant outcome evidence for NDIS audits 

Willing to learn new skills and adapt your approach to meet the individual needs of the person you support. 

Effective prioritising, problem solving, time management and decision-making skills. 

Demonstrated ability to assist with daily programs and organising activities/excursions. 

Effective communication skills with clients, families, and healthcare professionals. 

Cultural sensitivity and respect for diverse backgrounds 

Have positive past employment work references

Job description
Position Summary
The Graphic Pre-press is responsible for preparing, processing and converting customer artwork, images, text and design files into print-ready formats for commercial printing, packaging, labels and other visual media applications. The role ensures all pre-press activities meet customer specifications, production requirements and quality standards before printing commences. 
Main Duties and Responsibilities
Artwork and File Preparation
•	Review customer artwork and design files for printability and technical compliance.
•	Prepare, manipulate and format text, graphics and images for printing and digital output.
•	Generate layouts, page impositions and print-ready files using specialised pre-press software.
•	Perform pre-flight checks to identify and correct file errors before production.
•	Ensure artwork complies with customer specifications, dimensions and production requirements. 
Image Processing and Colour Management
•	Scan, edit, retouch and optimise digital images.
•	Perform colour correction, colour separation and colour matching processes.
•	Apply colour management systems and profiles to achieve accurate print reproduction.
•	Evaluate colour consistency and quality throughout the pre-press process. 
Proofing and Quality Control
•	Produce digital and hard-copy proofs for customer approval.
•	Review proofs against artwork specifications and printing requirements.
•	Identify and rectify errors relating to colour, positioning, text, image quality and layout.
•	Maintain quality assurance standards and compliance with company procedures. 
Plate and Output Preparation
•	Operate computer-to-plate (CTP) and other plate-making systems.
•	Prepare printing plates, films and digital output devices for production.
•	Ensure output files are compatible with printing equipment and workflows.
•	Monitor and maintain pre-press production systems and equipment. 
Production Support
•	Liaise with customers, designers, printers and production staff regarding artwork requirements.
•	Provide technical advice on print limitations, artwork preparation and production specifications.
•	Assist in troubleshooting pre-press and printing issues.
•	Support continuous improvement initiatives within the printing production workflow. 
________________________________________
Key Accountabilities
•	Accurate preparation of artwork and print-ready files.
•	Compliance with production schedules and customer deadlines.
•	Maintenance of colour accuracy and print quality standards.
•	Reduction of printing errors and production waste.
•	Efficient operation of pre-press systems and software.
•	Compliance with workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Effective communication with customers and internal stakeholders.
________________________________________
Typical Skills and Knowledge
•	Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).
•	PDF workflow management.
•	Pre-flight and imposition software.
•	Colour management systems and ICC profiles.
•	Computer-to-Plate (CTP) technology.
•	Print production processes including offset, flexographic and digital printing.
•	Quality assurance and proofing procedures. ________________________________________
Qualification Level
ANZSCO Skill Level 3
•	Typically requires:
•	AQF Certificate III in Printing and Graphic Arts (Pre-press) with relevant on-the-job training; or
•	AQF Certificate IV qualification; or
•	At least three years of relevant industry experience may substitute for formal qualifications in some circumstances.
Salary & Career Outlook
• Salary: Range from $75,000 to $85,000 per year, depending on the specific industry and experience level.

Our client, LL Frame & Truss (NSW) Pty Ltd, is a trusted supplier of precision-engineered timber frames and trusses across NSW. Backed by the founder's 23+ years of experience in the industry, LL Frame and Truss has built a reputation for delivering quality, cost-effective, and sustainable solutions to renowned builders.

The company specialises in prefabricated timber wall frames, roof trusses, laminated veneer lumber, flooring systems, and eaves packages, using advanced Pryda Engineering Software to ensure accuracy, compliance, and production efficiency. With a strong commitment to quality workmanship and reliable service, LL Frame & Truss continues to expand its manufacturing operations throughout NSW.

The client is currently seeking an experienced Wood Machinist to join its production team. This role is responsible for setting up and operating specialised woodworking machinery to manufacture precision timber components used in residential building projects. The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring that timber products are produced accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

-	Study production drawings, work orders and specifications to determine machining requirements and product dimensions. 
-	Determine appropriate tooling, machine settings and operational sequences for efficient timber processing. 
-	Set up and adjust woodworking machinery for cutting, planing, shaping, drilling, profiling and sanding timber components. 
-	Operate woodworking machines to manufacture timber frames, truss components, flooring systems and other engineered timber products to required specifications. 
-	Inspect finished components to verify dimensions, accuracy and quality, making adjustments where necessary. 
-	Assemble and fasten timber frame components and other prefabricated timber products as required during the manufacturing process. 
-	Carry out routine maintenance, cleaning and safety checks on woodworking machinery and equipment. 
-	Monitor material usage and minimise waste while maintaining production efficiency. 
-	Maintain a safe and organised work environment in accordance with workplace health and safety procedures. 
-	Work collaboratively with supervisors and production staff to ensure manufacturing schedules and customer delivery timeframes are achieved. 

Skills & Qualifications

-	AQF Certificate III in Wood Machining, Carpentry, Joinery or a closely related trade qualification, or equivalent. 
-	Minimum 1 year of full-time work experience as a Wood Machinist or in a similar timber manufacturing role. 
-	Demonstrated experience operating industrial woodworking machinery and equipment. 
-	Ability to read and interpret production drawings, cutting lists and technical specifications. 
-	Sound knowledge of timber materials, machining processes and quality control procedures. 
-	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality workmanship. 
-	Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a production team. 
-	Knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements within a manufacturing environment. 

The Successful Applicant

You will be required to work effectively within a team environment while maintaining high standards of accuracy, quality and productivity. Previous experience in timber manufacturing or prefabricated timber frame and truss production will be highly regarded.

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.
To apply for this position, email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au
